note: merit-v4 deterministic factual research backstop. Objective club-achievement facts that the parser source set does not carry but that are within the owner-ratified scope for contextualized individual merit: major trophy achievement, league top-scorer by goals, and world-record / era-defining transfer facts. Voting-decided awards, fan votes, player-of-the-year honors, and subjective club accolades are excluded. Each row is a citation-backed public fact: the player's canonical display name, nation, fact year, position, detail token, and fetchable citation URL plus the specific claim. No rating numbers, rankings, OVR/channel/boost/override, or per-player tuning are present; the conservative linker treats these rows identically to parser rows, and an uncited row fails the build.
